name: Charlotte
bio: One of the original two. Shy but friendly, and a bit of a loner who mostly keeps to herself. Classic boer coloring: dark brown head, white body.

name: Olivia
bio: One of the original two. Quirky and very food-driven. Keeps trying to lead the herd, but her son Enzo keeps taking it from her.

name: Lola
bio: One of the first goats on the farm. Arrived at about four years old and already pregnant. An udder infection and misshapen teats made it hard for her kids to feed.

name: Oline
when: died suddenly in 2024, possibly a twisted stomach
bio: Olivia's sister and one of the first original goats. Mother of Celina.

name: Alonso
bio: Half brother of Diego, bought from the same farm. Stayed with Enzo after Diego died, and fathered about three generations of kids.

name: Diego
when: died in fall 2024 from blue tongue
bio: Half brother of Alonso, bought from the same farm. Probably the father of Enzo, Choco, Channel and Frost.

name: Balder
bio: Second-generation buck from a different bloodline, brought in to replace Alonso. Shy but not aggressive. After two generations of kids he will become a teaser buck.

name: Bonita
bio: First goat born on the farm. Friendly and loves being petted, but not a great mom. Has survived listeria twice.

name: Lucifer
bio: The bottle baby who screamed for 24 hours straight. Thinks of people as his mom and will headbutt anyone in his way. Kept as a pet, to be castrated at three months.

name: Celina
bio: Very social. Loves being petted and brings her head to yours to ask for attention. Full brown with white hooves.

name: Enzo
bio: Herd leader, castrated at three months to keep Alonso company. Very friendly, and always wants his head rubbed.

name: Choco
bio: Twin of Channel. Outgoing, loves attention, and fights with Stella. Fully brown like Enzo.

name: Channel
bio: Twin of Choco. Very avoidant of people, but cares about one thing: her sister Choco.

name: Frost
bio: Shy and timid, but extremely sweet once she trusts you. Looks like a copy of her mother. Expected to have kids in spring 2027.

name: Stella
bio: Loves attention and gets jealous if someone pets the others. Rivals with Choco and Channel. Expected to have kids in spring 2027.

name: Alabama
bio: Outgoing, and will ram others for attention. Very close with her mom Celina.
